approach: under output axi a non-undefined value returned from run() is the answer, printed once on stdout in this.format, nothing on stderr; in the default console output nothing is printed, as before (axi-native RFC section 3.5, step 7 of section 6)
result(value, { help, render }), document(content) and empty(message, { help }) return answers tagged with Symbol.for('clibuilder.answer'); parse() resolves to the wrapped value in either output
a string is written verbatim; an array or a scalar is encoded under the result key; an empty state is encoded under the empty key
this.output exposes the output mode; the plugins builtins in core and @clibuilder/plugins return their report as the answer under output axi and keep their console output and return value
@clibuilder/axi's output.result() keeps writing and returns a written answer when clibuilder has the result channel, so it prints once in either output
scenarios added to the frozen execution and builtin-commands suites and to the plugins extension suite; no existing scenario changed
